tools.name: list_games
tools.description: Discover covered stack depths and positions. Call this before low-level preflop queries. "nl" = no-limit hold'em 6-max cash (169-grid hands, per-hand EV in small blinds), "nl9" = no-limit hold'em 9-max cash, "nlmtt8" = no-limit hold'em 8-max MTT chip-EV (10–300bb, 1bb BB-ante; Fold/Call/Limp/AI/Open/3B tokens), "nlh8-hydra" = no-limit hold'em 8-max MTT chip-EV with a classic 0.1bb ante from every seat (10, 20, 30, 60bb; same tokens as nlmtt8), "plo" = pot-limit Omaha 6-max cash (4-card), "plo5" = pot-limit Omaha 5-card 6-max (100bb, 1.2bb ante), "plo9" = pot-limit Omaha 9-max cash, "plo6hu" = 6-card Omaha heads-up (BTN vs BB, 100bb). Cash trees are not tournament, ICM, PKO, or satellite solves. nlmtt8 is chip-EV only.

detail.description: Response detail. "compact" is the default and removes bulk maps; use "full" only when exact complete data is required.

tools.name: get_range
tools.description: The GTO range for one spot. `spot` is an action path of POSITION_ACTION pairs ending in the action whose range you want, e.g. NLHE cash "UTG_60%_HJ_Call", nlmtt8 "UTG_Open", or PLO "UTG_Open_HJ_3B". Add `hand` for one exact frequency and EV. Compact mode is default; PLO returns representative pure/mixed hands unless a hand is specified; plo5 returns the top hands by EV that take the action (limit up to 500 compact, 2000 full).

tools.name: get_node
tools.description: Actions available at a decision node. `history` is an action path ending in the position about to act, e.g. "UTG_60%_HJ". sizeBb is the raise-to in big blinds and sizePctPot is the percent of the pot after calling (nlmtt8 40bb Open 40034 is 2.19bb; the pack label is 2.2x). evs are small blinds relative to fold. Compact mode returns action totals; add `hand` for its exact mixed strategy. full=true is full=1: all 169 hold'em hands with explicit 0, and no invented EVs.

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Table for one preflop game and stack, in big blinds: seats, stacks, blinds (sb 0.5, bb 1), ante, antePostedBy, stackIncludesAnte, openSizes (first-in raise-to), evUnit, evBaseline. Convergence is not published. stackIncludesAnte is true: the named depth is the starting stack and the 1bb BB ante is posted from it. openSizes at 40bb is open 2.2x (listing 2.2bb; node decodes code 40034 to 2.19bb) and SB 2.8x (2.8bb). 10bb is all-in/fold versus 50bb stacks, so stacks is null there. evs on nodes are small blinds relative to fold. Example: get_config({ game: "nlmtt8", stack: 40 }).

tools.description: Search valid decision nodes for a stack depth, tagged by depth (1 = RFI, 2 = vs open, 3 = 3-bet pots, …). Compact mode is paginated; use depth, contains, and offset to narrow results without loading thousands of paths. plo9 has no spot index: walk it with get_node from history "UTG".

tools.name: list_postflop_packs
tools.description: Every solved postflop pack: preflop line, positions (OOP vs IP), stack, pot, the bet-size trees it is solved under, and the solved boards. Boards use the spaced form ("3h 3d 2s"). NLHE packs list `sizingTrees`: "75" (75% pot every street, the pack id itself) and "33" (33% pot on the flop, then 75%, under the `<pack>-flop33` id); every postflop tool accepts either tree's packId. PLO5 packs (ids starting plo5-) solve one 33% flop tree, flop decisions only. Compact output lists board names per pack. Pass `pack` (the 75% id or the -flop33 id) for that tree's per-board detail and per-flop exploitability where the index publishes a number. Missing exploitability is omitted, never estimated. Pass `variant` to list only NLHE or PLO5 packs. Call this before get_postflop_node.

variant.description: Only packs of this game: nlhe (hold'em) or plo5 (five-card Omaha)

pack.description: One pack id (75% id or the -flop33 id): per-board detail and that tree's exploitability

detail.description: Response detail. "compact" is the default and removes bulk maps; use "full" only when exact complete data is required.

tools.name: get_postflop_node
tools.description: One postflop solver node: the acting player's strategy for every hand class, the legal next segments, board, reach and the reach-weighted action split. Walk deeper by appending a returned childSegment (an action like "Bet 5.5" or a runout like "deal:7c") to `path`.

pack.description: Pack id from list_postflop_packs. Use a sizingTrees packId to pick the tree: the pack id for 75% pot on the flop, or "<pack>-flop33" for 33%.

path.description: Segments from the root, e.g. ["Check", "Bet 5.5"]. Empty for the root node.

combo.description: Optional exact combo, e.g. AsKh (PLO5: five cards, as listed in the node's hands)

detail.description: Response detail. "compact" is the default and removes bulk maps; use "full" only when exact complete data is required.

tools.name: explain_combo
tools.description: Preferred tool for exact NLHE postflop hand questions. Returns a canonical context, exact action mix, action EV/loss when available, made-hand and draw classification, blocker facts, and same-rank-class suit comparisons. The server computes evidence; the agent should phrase causality as interpretation.

pack.description: Pack id from list_postflop_packs. Use a sizingTrees packId to pick the tree: the pack id for 75% pot on the flop, or "<pack>-flop33" for 33%.

path.description: Exact childSegment path from get_postflop_node, e.g. ["Check", "Bet 5.5"]. Empty for the root.

combo.description: Required exact two-card combo, e.g. As5s

format.description: Requested poker format. "cash" uses the cash trees. "mtt" is supported only for preflop chip-EV against game nlmtt8; ICM, PKO, and satellite remain unsupported.

objective.description: Requested optimization objective. chip_ev is supported for nlmtt8 preflop. ICM, PKO, and satellite return unsupported coverage.

anteBb.description: Requested ante in bb. nlmtt8 models a 1bb BB-ante; other positive antes return unsupported coverage.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List preflop datasets in the shipped tree documentation (stacks, positions, whether each bundle was analyzed). Preflop exploitability is not available.

tools.name: get_tree_docs
tools.description: Tree documentation for one dataset: coverage note from the shipped README and per-stack bundle or node counts from the shipped index. Does not read or modify range bytes.

tools.name: get_range_metadata
tools.description: Index metadata for one preflop game, stack, and path: bundle stats for hold'em/PLO bundles, or the matching node row for plo5 and plo6hu. Does not return a strategy and does not invent exploitability.

path.description: Action path, e.g. UTG_Open or LJ_Fold. Use (root) or empty for the plo5 root.

tools.name: get_exploitability
tools.description: Preflop exploitability for a game. No preflop dataset publishes exploitability, convergence, or iteration counts. The answer is not available; this tool never fills in a number.

tools.name: get_postflop_range
tools.description: The range a player takes one flop action with, from a solved pack: hand-class weights ("AA:1,AKs:0.42,...", same format as the preflop ranges) after every earlier flop action on the path. `path` ends in the action whose range you want, e.g. ["Check", "Bet 1.8", "Call 1.8"] for the check-call range. Bet-size tree. "33" = 33% pot on the flop, then 75% pot on the turn and river, plus all-in. "75" = 75% pot on every street, plus all-in. Compact and full detail apply to the other range tools; this returns the action range itself.

path.description: Flop actions ending in the action whose range you want

tools.name: find_hands
tools.description: Find hands the account has uploaded. Returns hand_id, session_id, handAt, position, cards, game, board, potType, street lines, and netBb. Solver grade buckets are not filled. If this account has no hands, offer the hosted upload page from get_upload_link (https://pokerdata.io/upload) instead of asking the user to paste histories into chat.

anyOf.description: Opener's action vs a 3-bet: fold, call, or raise (4-bet).

tools.name: get_hand_results
tools.description: Per-hand cumulative results for a winnings curve. `points` is [{ hand, bb }], oldest to newest, downsampled. Pass session_id for one session. If this account has no hands, offer the hosted upload page from get_upload_link (https://pokerdata.io/upload) instead of asking the user to paste histories into chat.

tools.name: get_session_summary
tools.description: Headline numbers and HUD rates for one uploaded session.

tools.name: list_my_sessions
tools.description: Recent uploaded sessions, newest first: id, hero, game type, dates, hands, and net result. game_type matches hole-card count. If this account has no hands, offer the hosted upload page from get_upload_link (https://pokerdata.io/upload) instead of asking the user to paste histories into chat.

tools.name: get_tournament_results
tools.description: MTT results imported from tournament summary files. Money is in cents. Hand histories are not a source of buy-ins or prizes. If this account has no hands, offer the hosted upload page from get_upload_link (https://pokerdata.io/upload) instead of asking the user to paste histories into chat.

tools.name: list_my_opponents
tools.description: Tracked opponents from uploaded hands. Each row has handCount, handsVsHero, and heroBb100Vs. Pass name to find one villain.

tools.name: get_opponent_notes
tools.description: Leak notes computed from uploaded hands for one opponent, with the sample size on each line.

tools.name: get_opponent_limp_range
tools.description: Shown-hand first-in limp range: 169-class counts of hole cards villains showed after an open limp. Pass position for one seat. Sample is showdown-only. This is not a solver range.

tools.name: enqueue_solve
tools.description: Record a heads-up postflop solve request. Required: title, board, pot (bb), effective_stack (bb). The job stays pending: solver dispatch and billing are not configured, so this does not start a solve.

tools.name: get_queued_solve
tools.description: Look up one queued solve for this account. status is pending, running, done, or failed. solution_id is null until a worker exists.

tools.name: list_queued_solves
tools.description: List this account's solver-queue jobs, newest first. Jobs are not dispatched.

tools.name: list_library_solutions
tools.description: Finished postflop solutions saved for this account. None are marked done while dispatch is disabled.

tools.name: get_upload_link
tools.description: Primary hand-upload path. Returns https://pokerdata.io/upload on this origin, with a short-lived signed token for the caller's account when signing is configured. Hand the URL to the user. Pasting histories into chat is the fallback.

tools.name: upload_hand_history
tools.description: Secondary upload path for a small paste. Prefer get_upload_link and the hosted /upload page. Runs the same ingestion pipeline and returns hands parsed, tournaments parsed, and errors. Does not grade solver frequencies.

text.description: Raw hand history or tournament summary text.
